transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Honestly, I came in because my eating’s been really all over the place. Some days I’ll just forget to eat meals, and then other nights I’m up after midnight tearing through takeout and snacks. It’s starting to scare me a little.
After these episodes of eating, do you ever do anything to try to compensate, such as making yourself throw up, taking laxatives, or exercising excessively?
No, I don’t do anything like that afterward. I just feel kind of bad about it, but I don’t try to make up for it.
Do these late-night eating episodes happen after you have already fallen asleep and woken up?
No, I’m awake when it happens. I’ll be up late and then just start going through takeout or snacks after midnight.
During these late-night eating episodes, do you feel like you can't stop eating or can't control how much you are eating?
I'm not really sure. I know I eat a lot sometimes, but I haven't really paid attention to whether I feel out of control.
Do you typically have an appetite in the morning, or do you usually skip breakfast?
Most mornings I don’t really eat—I kind of forget meals sometimes. Then other nights I end up eating a lot of takeout and snacks after midnight.
Do you feel that you need to eat in order to fall asleep?
Not exactly. Some days I just forget to eat, and then other nights I’m up late tearing through takeout and snacks. It’s been pretty all over the place, honestly.
Would you say you eat at least a quarter of all your food for the day after your evening meal or late at night?

Yeah, I think so, at least on those nights. I’ll barely eat during the day sometimes, then after midnight I’m eating a lot of takeout and snacks. It’s been really inconsistent, and honestly that’s what scared me enough to come in.
